verdict.rationale: Copilot documents general-purpose autonomous agents: agent mode edits workspace files and validates them, the cloud agent completes tasks in the background "just like a human developer", and @copilot can be asked to change existing pull requests. None of the evidence names the four specific chores, so coverage of this story is only implied by generic agent capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of test generation, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, and dependency updates, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of any of them.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: Edit files in your workspace in agent mode
proposing edits and validating files with agent mode
With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
Mention `@copilot` in a comment on an existing pull request to ask it to make changes.
